description: This file defines a Mapper interface using MapStruct for mapping between Command and CommandEntity objects in the Fineract project, specifically within the command persistence layer. It includes mapping configurations and annotations for dependency injection via Spring.
external_methods: mapstruct.Mapper(componentModel = SPRING, injectionStrategy = CONSTRUCTOR, uses = { CommandJsonMapper.class })

classes.name: CommandMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct interface for converting between Command and CommandEntity objects, used for persistence mappings within the Fineract command module.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a Command object into a CommandEntity object, ignoring the 'id' field and mapping other fields accordingly.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a CommandEntity object back into a Command object, utilizing inherited inverse configuration.
